Subject: Monday Morning Deliverables

Good Morning All -

Per our conversation, we are delivering a few items to move the portfolio forward:

  *
Proposed email templates communicating the decisions made by the SLT
  *
An overview of the Momentum Room process and meeting templates
  *
An overview the CI Working Sessions and how to select and organize them.

Thanks!
